name: @pipeworx/mcp-us-national-archives

tools.name: nara_search
tools.description: Keyword-search the US National Archives Catalog — the descriptions of the federal government's permanent records: agency files, military service and unit records, photographs, motion pictures, maps, treaties, presidential library holdings and artifacts. Returns each record's NAID, title, dates, archival hierarchy (record group → series → item) and whether scans are available online. AUTHORITATIVE for US federal archival holdings; PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "does the National Archives hold records about X", "NARA records on X". Example: nara_search({ query: "Apollo 11 moon", available_online: true, limit: 10 })

query.description: Keywords — a person, event, place, unit, agency or subject, e.g. "Apollo 11 moon"

page.description: 1-based page number (default 1). NARA pages by page, not offset

available_online.description: Only records that have digitised files attached (default false)

record_group_number.description: Restrict to one NARA record group, e.g. "255" (NASA)

include_digital_objects.description: Include the full digital-object list on every hit (default false — use nara_digital_objects for one record)

tools.name: nara_record
tools.description: Fetch one US National Archives Catalog record in full by its NAID (National Archives Identifier, the number in a catalog.archives.gov/id/ URL). Returns title, scope and content note, dates, access and use restrictions, the full archival hierarchy back to the record group, and the digital objects attached. Example: nara_record({ naid: "219756158" })

naid.description: National Archives Identifier, e.g. "219756158" — the number in a catalog.archives.gov/id/ URL

tools.name: nara_digital_objects
tools.description: List the digitised files attached to one US National Archives Catalog record — scanned page images, PDFs, audio and video — with a direct, public-domain download URL, file type and size for each. Use after nara_search or nara_record when you want the actual document rather than its description. Example: nara_digital_objects({ naid: "219756158" })

naid.description: National Archives Identifier of the record whose scans you want, e.g. "219756158"

limit.description: Maximum digital objects to return (default 50, max 500)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-us-national-archives forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the us-national-archives pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
